mapper.sql: t.id, t.club_id, t.school_year, t.architecture_material, t.backbone_material, t.activity_material, t.fund_material, t.attach_opinion, t.result, t.submit_time, t.review_user_id, t.review_time, t.publicity_id, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted, c.club_name AS club_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(ru.real_name, ''), ru.nickname, ru.username) AS review_user_name
FROM club_review t LEFT JOIN club c ON c.id = t.club_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users ru ON ru.id = t.review_user_id AND ru.deleted = 0

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_member cm JOIN student_profile csp ON csp.user_id = cm.user_id AND csp.deleted = 0 WHERE cm.club_id = t.club_id AND cm.deleted = 0 AND cm.quit_date IS NULL AND csp.counselor_id = #{scopeCounselorId})
AND (c.club_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.school_year LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO club_review (club_id, school_year, architecture_material, backbone_material, activity_material, fund_material, attach_opinion, result, submit_time, review_user_id, review_time, publicity_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{clubId}, #{schoolYear}, #{architectureMaterial}, #{backboneMaterial}, #{activityMaterial}, #{fundMaterial}, #{attachOpinion}, #{result}, #{submitTime}, #{reviewUserId}, #{reviewTime}, #{publicityId}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
